question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A room in a hospital used especially for sunbathing or therapeutic exposure to light
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Sanatorium"** refers to a medical facility for long-term illness, typically associated with treatment of tuberculosis. (स्वास्थ्य सुधारगृह)

 
 
• **Example: **The patient was moved to a sanatorium for specialized care.
 
 
 
• **"Solarium" **is a room in a hospital used especially for sunbathing or therapeutic exposure to light. (सूर्य स्नान कक्ष)
 
 
• **Example: **After the surgery, he spent time in the solarium to aid in his recovery.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct term for a room in a hospital used especially for sunbathing or therapeutic exposure to light is **'Solarium' **. (सूर्य स्नान कक्ष)

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Planetarium **(नक्षत्रालय): A building or room in which images of stars, planets, and constellations are projected on the inner surface of a dome.

 
 
• **Example:** We visited the planetarium to learn about the solar system.
 
 
 
• **Podium **(मंच ): A small platform on which a person may stand to be seen by an audience, as when making a speech or conducting an orchestra.
 
 
• **Example: **The speaker stepped up to the podium to deliver his address.
